system.description: The character can transmit loads of information straight into another's mind.
system.effect: The character transmits a knowledge-based label (a trait or tag) of their own to a target with whom they have established a telepathic link-willing or not. The label lasts until the target sleeps. The character can also impart any other kind of knowledge they have to a target this way. The process is almost instantaneous.

outcomes.label: Choose knowledge or one knowledge-based trait or tag the character possesses. Confirm an existing telepathic link; the shared label expires when the target sleeps.
